summary_en: CPSNet is a label-free deep-unfolding framework for lung-ultrasound reconstruction and B-line analysis. It unfolds Cauchy proximal splitting into a forward-backward network and introduces a Radon-Based Neighbor Reconstruction Loss that trains from subsampled measurement consistency rather than paired clean images. The method preserves line structures under noise, runs at approximately 0.01 seconds per frame, and uses B-line detection to demonstrate clinical utility. Because reconstruction and acoustic image formation are central to the contribution, it belongs in the core library rather than only the downstream-analysis candidate set.
